content.json:
# VidGen operations

Every panel below is built from three sources, and from nothing else:

* **T23 structured logs** - redacted JSON on stdout, shipped to `ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL`.
* **T23 provider spans** - the `provider.request` span emitted by `instrument_provider_attempt`, in `AppDependencies`.
* **Azure platform metrics** - replica counts, CPU, memory, PostgreSQL, Redis and Storage, in `AzureMetrics`.

No prompt, transcript, caption, credential, signed URL or media payload reaches any of them: T23 redaction runs before a record is emitted, and the span attributes are bounded to provider, model, operation, status, failure class, latency and cost.

Panel titles name the T23 instrument each one corresponds to.

content.query:
// VidGen writes redacted structured JSON to stdout; Container Apps ships it here.
let vidgen = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend payload = parse_json(Log_s)
| where isnotnull(payload)
| extend
    level = tostring(payload.level),
    message = tostring(payload.message),
    projectId = tostring(payload.projectId),
    provider = tostring(payload.provider),
    model = tostring(payload.model),
    operation = tostring(payload.operation),
    stage = tostring(payload.stage),
    status = tostring(payload.status),
    failureClass = tostring(payload.failureClass),
    errorCode = tostring(payload.errorCode),
    durationMs = todouble(payload.durationMs),
    costUsd = todouble(payload.costUsd);
vidgen
| where message has_any ("project started", "project completed")
| summarize started = countif(message has "project started"),
            completed = countif(message has "project completed")
          by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: Projects started and completed (recap_projects_started / recap_projects_completed)

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.APP"
| where MetricName in ("Replicas", "UsageNanoCores", "WorkingSetBytes")
| summarize value = avg(Average) by MetricName, Resource, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: Worker replica count and resource usage

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Name == "provider.request"
| extend provider = tostring(Properties["provider.name"]),
         model = tostring(Properties["provider.model"]),
         operation = tostring(Properties["provider.operation"])
| summarize p50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50), p95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95)
          by provider, operation, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: Provider latency p50/p95 (recap_provider_latency_seconds)

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.DBFORPOSTGRESQL"
| where MetricName in ("cpu_percent", "memory_percent", "active_connections", "storage_percent")
| summarize value = avg(Average) by MetricName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| render timechart

content.query:

content.query:
StorageBlobLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where StatusCode >= 400
| summarize errors = count() by StatusText, OperationName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: Blob Storage errors

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT"
| summarize reads = count() by identity_claim_appid_g, OperationName, ResultSignature
| order by reads desc
content.title: Key Vault secret reads

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Name == "provider.request"
| extend operation = tostring(Properties["provider.operation"])
| where operation startswith "youtube."
| summarize attempts = count() by operation, status = tostring(Properties["provider.status"])
| order by attempts desc
content.title: T25 publication outcomes (youtube.* provider attempts)

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Name == "provider.request"
| extend operation = tostring(Properties["provider.operation"])
| where operation startswith "youtube."
| summarize p50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50), p95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), operation
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: T25 YouTube operation latency p50/p95

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Name == "provider.request"
| extend operation = tostring(Properties["provider.operation"]), failure = tostring(Properties["provider.failure_class"])
| where operation startswith "youtube." and isnotempty(failure)
| summarize failures = count() by failure, operation
| order by failures desc
content.title: T25 publication failure classification

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Properties["service.name"] == "vidgen-publisher"
| summarize value = avg(Sum / Count) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Name
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: T25 publisher worker replicas and resource usage

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Name == "provider.request"
| extend operation = tostring(Properties["provider.operation"])
| where operation startswith "youtube."
| summarize units = sum(toint(Properties["quota_units"])) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), operation
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: T25 YouTube quota units consumed (a rate limit, never a charge)
